title: Added Value of Viscoelasticity for MRI-Based Prediction of Ki-67 Expression of Hepatocellular Carcinoma Using a Deep Learning Combined Radiomics (DLCR) Model
summary: The study reports prediction performance for the pathology label in its evaluated patient images. The result is bounded to the retrospective study cohort; prospective clinical utility and generalization are not established.
ai_technology: A deep-learning radiomics model combines MRI and viscoelasticity to predict pathology-measured Ki-67 expression in hepatocellular carcinoma.
organization: Human Phenome Institute, Fudan University, Shanghai, China
